text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 3,700 million markka median forecast for Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by 21 analysts, EPS by 19 analysts). @
UPM-Kymmene's results are due on March 4 at 0900/0700 GMT.
In 1995, UPM-Kymmene had a 6.30 billion markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.

Fourteen of the analysts polled also gave forecasts for UPM-Kymmene's dividend for 1996 with the median at 3.90 markka (mean 3.70 markka) in a 2.70-4.50 markka range. The 1995 dividend was 4.50 markka.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 16 of the 21 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 3.90 billion markka (mean 3.90 million) in a 2.20-6.20 billion markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, BZW Securities, Carnegie Securities, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock, Paribas, Postipankki, UBS and Williams de Broe.
